_doc: The Almanac of the World (systems/almanac.js, ui/actionMenu/almanac.js): a searchable, cross-linked encyclopedia over what the game already records. `cats` are the Almanac's parts (its tabs), in order. `caps` bound its lists so a long save stays quick: `townsfolk` acquaintances and `npcs` known people indexed, `lines` kept per page, `houseHistory` House Chronicle lines read, `search` results, `list` rows shown before 'Show more', `townAnnals` lines of a town's talk, `memories` remembered deeds shown per person or town. `eras` name the town eras (data/townEras.json ids). `kinds` are the entries' icons. `battleKinds` are the Timeline events that become battle pages. Names shorter than `minNameLength` are not linked in text.
